title: Lightweight security protocols for IoT networks
summary: OSCORE and EDHOC on constrained devices, benchmarked.
description:
Research on lightweight key establishment for resource-constrained IoT devices: I implemented and evaluated the OSCORE and EDHOC protocols on ESP32 and Raspberry Pi devices.

The evaluation benchmarked authentication methods, hardware acceleration, memory usage, latency and power consumption, to show the trade-offs between security, efficiency and energy.
